sites.title: New Alexandria
sites.note: Tower roofs, skybridges, tram rings and landing pads at true scale. Street level and building interiors are built by us from Reach city kit so every block is enterable inside and out. The ONI building pyramid becomes the island landmark.

sites.title: Reflection
sites.old: Penthouse in a New Alexandria tower
sites.note: The penthouse lobby sits at the top of the Broadcast Tower, inside the New Alexandria skyline.

sites.title: Penance
sites.note: Industrial interior under the Power Station, reached from the plant floor.

sites.title: Exodus
sites.note: Beach, stadium and old-town streets run north from the river bank. Beachhead (Firefight) is already inside it.

sites.title: Breakneck
sites.note: Industrial block of the city, it replaces Foundry Row.

sites.title: Sword Base
sites.old: North, inside its own cliff-walled valley
sites.note: The base, its courtyard and the canyon. The Sword Base multiplayer map and the Courtyard Firefight map are the base interior and yard, so they are already here.

sites.title: Sabre launch facility
sites.old: Centre-north highlands, between Sword Base and the city
sites.note: Where the mission starts. The Sabre launch pad is the beam-up point to the corvette, and the corvette hangs in the sky above it.

sites.title: Countdown
sites.note: The launch station interior, joined to the Sabre facility by a service road.

sites.title: Breakpoint
sites.note: Snowbound ONI site on the ranges, between Sword Base and the mountains.

sites.title: High Noon
sites.note: Walled canyon yard, it replaces the Munitions Depot.

sites.title: The Package
sites.old: North-east, the same valley in winter, up in the mountains
sites.note: Sword Base valley under snow, plus Dr. Halsey's lab and the ice caves. Glacier and Outpost (Firefight) are parts of it.

sites.title: Nightfall
sites.old: South-west ridges, beside Tip of the Spear as in the game
sites.note: The rocky ridge and pools at night. Waterfront (Firefight) is part of it.

sites.title: Powerhouse
sites.old: Centre, the dam on the river down from the highlands
sites.note: The dam and its village, the purge goal from the PLANS list.

sites.title: Solitary
sites.note: Prison block for the quarantine camp.

sites.title: Winter Contingency
sites.old: North-west highlands, inside its own Visegrád valley
sites.note: Visegrád farms, the relay outpost and the Covenant camp. Its farmhouses set the look for every rebuilt farm town.

sites.title: Highlands
sites.note: Hilltop training preserve west of the farms.

sites.title: Overlook
sites.old: West, a bluff off Winter Contingency
sites.note: The lookout bluff at the south end of Winter Contingency.

sites.title: Tip of the Spear
sites.old: South-west plains, beside Nightfall as in the game
sites.note: Open plains, the Spire and the Covenant camp. The Spire multiplayer map is the spire itself, so it is already here.

sites.title: Unearthed
sites.old: South, dig site on the plains
sites.note: Dig site beside the plains.

sites.title: Battle Canyon
sites.note: Creek canyon, it replaces the Hollow Creek hamlet.

sites.title: Ridgeline
sites.note: Forest valley inside the south woods.

sites.title: The Pillar of Autumn
sites.note: Aszod ship-breaking yards and the Pillar of Autumn on the coast. Boneyard (multiplayer) and Holdout (Firefight) are parts of it.

sites.title: Lone Wolf
sites.note: The cliff with the anti-air gun, at the tip of the point.

sites.title: Boardwalk
sites.old: East coast seafront south of the city
sites.note: Seaside promenade, it replaces the Seabright boardwalk.

sites.title: Tempest
sites.note: Forerunner island off the south coast.

sites.title: Forge World
sites.note: Its cliffs, beach and rock pieces also go into the coast where sites meet the sea.

sites.title: Installation 04
sites.note: Cliffs and waterfall on the north cape.

orbit.title: Corvette hull
orbit.note: The outside of the ship, also used as the model you see from the ground.

orbit.title: Command deck
orbit.note: Bow. Final fight and the slipspace drive.

orbit.title: Long hall
orbit.note: Connects the bow to the hangar.

orbit.title: Hangar
orbit.note: Where the Sabre lands. Beam-up arrives here.

orbit.title: Reactor room
orbit.note: Round reactor room at the middle of the ship.

orbit.title: Aft decks
orbit.note: The mission never builds the back half of the ship. Zealot is a Covenant ship interior, so it becomes the aft decks and engines.

orbit.title: Anchor 9
orbit.note: UNSC station in the same orbit; reachable by dropship from the hangar.

orbit.title: Condemned
orbit.note: The damaged Anchor 9 section, docked to it.
